data_description.account_id: The account number in the usages request Mijn Eneco makes (…/customers/<customer ID>/accounts/<account number>/usages). Usually 1, but it can change after a contract change.
data_description.api_key: The static "apikey" header value used by mijn-eneco (see the integration's README for how to find this).
data_description.session_token: The __Secure-next-auth.session-token cookie value, copied from your browser's DevTools after logging in to eneco.nl by hand.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Eneco Data
reauth_confirm.description: Eneco rejected the stored credentials. Log in to eneco.nl by hand and paste a fresh session token. If the apikey changed, paste the new one as well.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid session token - it may be expired. Log in to eneco.nl by hand and copy a fresh one.
error.invalid_api_key: Eneco rejected the API key. Copy the current apikey header from a mijn-eneco request.
error.invalid_account: Eneco doesn't know this account number. Check the number in the usages request Mijn Eneco makes.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Eneco API.

abort.already_configured: This Eneco customer is already configured.

data_description.account_id: The account number in the usages request Mijn Eneco makes. Change it if Eneco moved you to a new account.
data_description.heat_price: Variable heat tariff per GJ, incl. VAT. When above 0, a cost statistic (eneco_data:heat_cost) is imported that you can pick as the cost source on the Energy Dashboard. 0 turns it off.
